replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions. First, standardize your data. Then, calculate the covariance matrix. Find eigenvalues and eigenvectors of that matrix. Arrange eigenvectors by eigenvalue size. Finally, project your data onto the new eigenvectors. Don't be anxious; it's just linear algebra, which I find manageable with practice.
